text: The applicant was born in 1962.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The applicant lives in Istanbul.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: At the material time, the applicant was a civil servant in the Metropolitan Municipality of Istanbul.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: At the material time, the applicant was a member of the local branch of the Tümbel-Sen trade union.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The Tümbel-Sen trade union is affiliated to the KESK (Kamu Emekçileri Sendikaları Konfederasyonu – the Confederation of Public Employees' Trade Unions).
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: In April 2008, the DİSK (Devrimci İşçi Sendikaları Konfederasyonu – Confederation of Revolutionary Workers' Trade Unions) announced that it was planning a large-scale demonstration in Istanbul for 1 May 2008.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: In April 2008, the KESK (Kamu Emekçileri Sendikaları Konfederasyonu – Confederation of Public Employees' Trade Unions) announced that it was planning a large-scale demonstration in Istanbul for 1 May 2008.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The DİSK and the KESK announced that their members would be gathering on 1 May 2008 to celebrate Labour Day.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The DİSK and the KESK announced that their members would be gathering on 1 May 2008 to commemorate friends who had lost their lives during the demonstrations of 1 May 1977.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: In May 2008, the applicant was informed that a disciplinary investigation had been initiated against him for being absent without leave on 1 May 2008.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The applicant was asked to submit his defence submissions in connection with the disciplinary investigation initiated against him for being absent without leave on 1 May 2008.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The applicant explained that he had participated in a demonstration organised by his trade union on 1 May 2008 to celebrate International Labour Day.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The applicant was given a warning as a disciplinary sanction owing to his being absent without leave on 1 May 2008.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The disciplinary sanction of a warning was imposed on the applicant pursuant to section 125 of the Civil Servants Act (Law no. 657).
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: On 13 May 2008, the applicant objected to the disciplinary warning decision and requested its annulment.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: On 16 May 2008, the Disciplinary Board of the Istanbul Municipality dismissed the applicant's objection to the disciplinary warning decision.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The Disciplinary Board of the Istanbul Municipality found that the contested disciplinary warning decision was in accordance with the law.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The Disciplinary Board of the Istanbul Municipality found that there were no grounds to annul the disciplinary warning decision.
